allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://onnexa-dashboard.vercel.app/api/meta-ads/sync" -Method GET -TimeoutSec 30 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Output $r.Content.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(600, $r.Content.Length\)\) } catch { Write-Output "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)"; if \($_.Exception.Response\) { Write-Output "Status: $\([int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode\)" } })
